title: kushagra dead
description: Kushagra dead, causing sewage blockage in NCU

title: Deep pothole near Inner Circle, Block A
description: Large pothole about 2 ft wide right at the turn from Inner Circle into Block A. Two-wheelers are swerving into traffic to avoid it. Worse after last night's rain.

comments.text: Saw a scooter skid here this morning. Needs urgent fixing.

title: Overflowing garbage bins at Lajpat Nagar Central Market
description: The community bins behind the market have not been cleared for 4 days. Waste is spilling onto the road and stray animals are scattering it.

comments.text: A truck came by yesterday but only cleared half of it.

title: Streetlights not working on Sector 10 main road
description: Around 6 consecutive streetlights between the metro station and the park are off. The stretch is completely dark after 7 pm, which feels unsafe for people walking home.

title: Water pipeline leaking near Rohini Sector 7 market
description: Clean water has been gushing from a cracked pipe under the footpath for two days. The road is waterlogged and a lot of water is being wasted.

comments.text: Reported to the local office too.
Fixed today! Pipe has been replaced.

title: Open sewer manhole outside Noida Sector 62 metro
description: Manhole cover is missing near exit gate 2. It's a serious hazard, especially at night. Someone has put a few bricks around it as a warning.

comments.text: Barricade was put up today, cover still missing.

title: Traffic signal stuck on red at Cyber City junction
description: The signal at the junction near DLF Cyber Hub has been stuck on red for the eastbound lane since morning, causing a long jam back to NH-48.

title: Garbage dumped on footpath, Ajmal Khan Road
description: Shopkeepers are dumping packaging waste on the footpath every evening. Pedestrians have to walk on the road.

comments.text: Happens near the shoe shops every day.

title: Sewage overflow outside Saket Select City Walk
description: Sewage water is overflowing from the drain on the service lane. The smell is terrible and the water has spread onto the road.

title: Series of potholes on Outer Ring Road near Rohini
description: Multiple potholes along a 200 m stretch near the flyover. Buses are slowing down sharply and causing traffic.

title: Flickering streetlight near Golf Course Road
description: Streetlight pole number 47 keeps flickering on and off. It has been like this for over a week.

title: Stray cattle blocking road at Dwarka Sector 6
description: A group of cattle sits in the middle of the road near the market every evening, blocking one full lane.

title: Water leaking from main line, Karol Bagh
description: Continuous leak from a pipe joint near Gaffar Market. A small pond has formed and mosquitoes are breeding.

title: Broken road divider at Noida Sector 18
description: Part of the road divider has collapsed after a truck hit it. Debris is lying on the road.

title: Small pothole outside Regal Building
description: A new pothole is forming near the bus stop. Small now, but it will grow quickly with heavy traffic.
